title: Strict transform preserves universally exact short exact sequences
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes and $\mathcal I\subset\mathcal O_S$ a finite-type quasi-coherent ideal. Let $b:S^b=\operatorname{Bl}_{\mathcal I}S\to S$ be its blowup [def-nagata-global-blowup]. Suppose $0\to\mathcal F_1\to\mathcal F_2\to\mathcal F_3\to0$ is a short exact sequence of quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules whose pullback to $X\times_ST$ remains exact for every morphism $T\to S$. Then the induced sequence of module strict transforms [def-trf-module-strict-transform] $0\to\mathcal F_1^b\to\mathcal F_2^b\to\mathcal F_3^b\to0$ on $X\times_SS^b$ is short exact. Pullback here means extension of scalars on module sheaves [def-pc-module-pullback].

proof.text: Use isInvertible_comap_blowupMap and its locally principal consequence for the centre on the blowup B. For each y in Y=X times_S B, choose an affine principal neighbourhood V=Spec A of q(y), and an affine Z=Spec R containing y inside q^{-1}V. The map rho=q.appLE V Z defines the A-algebra structure on R. SpecMap_appLE_fromSpec gives z;q=Spec(rho);v. The local generator a of the centre on V identifies v^{-1}(centre complement) with D(a) by the support/zero-locus and fromSpec/basic-open identities. Pulling back this equality gives z^{-1}(moduleStrictTransformOpen f I)=D(rho(a)). This is proved in the private exists_principal_affine_chart lemma; no regularity of rho(a) is asserted.

proof.text: Apply universalExact_affine_power_reduction to f, t=I.blowupMap and each compatible affine chart. It supplies the three invertible tilde/Gamma counits and injectivity, exactness and surjectivity of the section sequence. For each n, take the final divisibility implication in its quotient-ring comparison. The private quotSMulTop_map_injective_of_divisibility proves injectivity of QuotSMulTop.map(alpha^n,i): lift a class to m, write i(m)=alpha^n*x when its image is zero, use divisibility to write m=alpha^n*y, and conclude its class is zero.

The chart counits and the open equality of Step 1 now supply every hypothesis of openSupportQuotient_shortExact_of_affine.

proof.text: Use hbase with T=I.blowup to form the complex H of pulled-back modules on Y, retaining its zero composite. Apply openSupportQuotient_shortExact_of_affine to H and moduleStrictTransformOpen f I with the chart data of Steps 1-3. The generic quotient objects and maps unfold definitionally to moduleStrictTransform and moduleStrictTransformMap, respectively. Thus the resulting zero composite and short exactness have precisely the unchanged statement of the item.
